text: Assumption: Read access is thread-safe — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Read access is thread-safe — is this correct?
rationale: SWS_CORE_01734 declares to_ulong as const and exception safe; the related alias SWS_CORE_01738 in the same scope is explicitly designated as thread-safe.
